ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Perl Reverse Shell Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the perl binary with the "-e" flag and common strings related to potential reverse shell activity

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/perl$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-e\\ .*")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*fdopen\\(.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\:Socket\\:\\:INET.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*Socket.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*connect.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*open.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*exec.*"))))
